dimensions.assessment: Affects importers, researchers, zoos, aquariums, and entities holding federal wildlife or quarantine permits.
dimensions.evidence: any person that violates this section may be assessed a civil penalty

dimensions.assessment: Imposes civil penalties up to $20,000 per violation, criminal fines up to $100,000, and cancellation of federal wildlife permits.
dimensions.evidence: civil penalty by the Secretary of not more than $20,000 for each such violation

dimensions.assessment: The source does not specify major federal spending or revenue changes, though violators are liable for storage and maintenance costs of seized sloths.
dimensions.evidence: Any person convicted of an offense, or assessed a civil penalty... shall be liable for the costs incurred

dimensions.assessment: Amends federal wildlife importation restrictions, creates specific statutory exceptions, and establishes penalty and forfeiture authorities for the Secretary.
dimensions.evidence: It is unlawful for any person to import any individual of a covered sloth species.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent prohibition on certain sloth importations and ongoing regulatory enforcement powers.

missing_information: Exact number of sloths or businesses currently involved in the affected trade is not provided.
Estimated administrative costs for the Department of the Interior are not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits the importation of certain sloth species with specific research and breeding exceptions, and establishes civil and criminal penalties for violators.
